attempted_claim: Let Gamma be a finite connected triangle-free simplicial graph with at least 5 vertices which is not a star, such that Gamma has at least one leaf, has a separating intersection of links, no two distinct leaves have the same link, and Gamma minus st(v) is connected for every leaf v. Let A_Gamma be the right-angled Artin group on Gamma. Is every subgroup H <= Out(A_Gamma) either virtually abelian or containing a non-abelian free group F_2?
decisive_failure: The domination lemmas and exhaustive n=5,6 enumeration rule out only elementary transvection-level Heisenberg, UT3 and Baumslag-Solitar violators; they do not control arbitrary mixed partial-conjugation, transvection and Torelli subgroups, and a full JSJ plus train-track proof or an exotic solvable-subgroup disproof remains open and would require machinery beyond this pass.
